description: Read a gov.near.org forum thread in full: House of Stake proposals and their debate, validator threads, incident write-ups, developer standards. Takes the topic number or the gov.near.org URL that search, semantic_search and get_proposal give, and returns the posts in order, 15 at a time.

from_post.description: First post to return, for reading past the first 15. A URL ending in a post number starts there.

topic.description: Topic number (42644) or its gov.near.org URL (https://gov.near.org/t/slug/42644).

name: get_discussion
